title: NONDISPLAY, credential and raw-wire secrecy
summary: Raw credentials live only in the trusted credential/runtime/wire layer. Safe snapshots, WatchAlong, replay, known-state persistence and AI-facing automation expose masks such as <SECRET>, never secret field contents.
invariants: Credentials are prompted locally rather than accepted from argv/environment by PUB400 tools.
Credential providers are queried only after exact known-state matching.
NONDISPLAY field contents are not persisted in known-state exemplars.
Raw outbound READ response bytes are not a safe automation result.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
